title: perf(console): answer an app page's views, page and dashboard reads from the app bundle first
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbNiiAtyW6uY3eTDyWYkBLff)_

Part of #28645

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:进入应用后,页面、仪表盘名称和对象视图优先从应用元数据包(bundle)读取;控制台在根部只进入一次 bundle;“对象是否存在”的检查不再拉视图列表。
- 为什么改:这是 #28645 的第一步。读者不再依赖整张 page/dashboard 列表后,下一步(PR 2,#28680)才能去掉导航同步的这两次列表读取。
- 风险与回滚:风险在对象视图的组合,bundle 外的对象仍按 `/meta/view` 列表组合;回滚即还原本 PR,无数据或协议变更。
- 先看:`ui/packages/app-shell/src/providers/MetadataProvider.tsx`(`viewsForObjects`、`peekBundle`)、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/appObjectScope.ts`(`enterAppBundle`)、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/PageView.tsx`。
- 两分钟验证:`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/providers/__tests__/MetadataProvider.bundleFirstReads-28645.test.tsx`,预期 17 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

The app metadata bundle (#27627) answers by-name reads, but the console's readers looked names up in whole lists. This PR moves those readers to the bundle first:

- **`MetadataProvider`** stops reading `/meta/view` at mount (`EAGER_TYPES = ['app']`). A route's object scope composes each object the bundle holds with the bundle's views. It reads the `/meta/view` list only when a name it asks is outside the bundle, and only for the objects the bundle does not hold. A list already in hand keeps answering while a bundle loads, so a settled scope never unsettles. The whole registry (`objects`) still reads the list beside it.
- **Bundle-first by-name reads** (`providers/bundledReads.ts`): `PageView`, `AppContent`'s page scope, `AppHeader`'s phone title, `useRecentItemLabel` and `useNavTargetLabel` read a page or dashboard from the bundle, prefer-local by owner package. A miss falls back to the list as before.
- **One bundle entry, at the console root**: `useAppObjectScopePrefetch` enters the app's bundle as soon as the app list names the app. `AppContent` reuses that entry (`enterAppBundle`) instead of revalidating it. Leaving the app ends the entry.
- **`useObjectPresence`** asks its object with a package-local `views: false` and reads no views.
- **`useServedViewItems(read)`**: `AppHeader` reads views only on an object's view route.
- **`@object-ui/data-objectstack`**: new `ObjectStackAdapter.peekAppBundle()` and the exported types `AppBundlePeek`, `AppBundleItems`, `AppBundleEntry`, with TSDoc. This is the Clause-② widening.

`NavigationSyncEffect` (`useNavigationSync.ts`) is untouched. It still reads `/meta/page` and `/meta/dashboard`, which PR 2 removes (#28680, maintainer ruling A).

## Tests

- New `MetadataProvider.bundleFirstReads-28645.test.tsx` (17 cases) and `appBundlePeek-28645.test.ts` (5 cases). `appObjectScope-12811.test.tsx` adds the root bundle entry and its reuse through the console's adapter wrapper.
- Updated pins that relied on the eager view read: `objectScope-12811`, `namesOnlyScope-12980`, `oneMetadataRead-13044`, `switchDropsAdapter-13044`, `ConnectedShell.sessionGate`.
- Each new rule was ablated and each one turned its pin red: eager view, bundle views, `views: false`, the pending-before-enter rule, bundled objects keeping bundle views, and the root entry.

## Acceptance notes

Measured on a production console build (`pnpm build` + `pnpm console:build`, `pnpm dev -- --fresh`), `showcase_app`, admin, API calls of a warm reload, two runs each. Base `2678600d`, head of this PR:

| Route | Base | PR 1 | Difference |
|---|---|---|---|
| `page/showcase_start_here` | 26 | 26 | `/meta/view` −1, `/api/v1/packages` +1 |
| `dashboard/showcase_ops_dashboard` | 35 | 35 | none |
| `showcase_task` (object list) | 33 | 33 | none |

Expected with PR 2 (NavigationSyncEffect stops reading the lists): page 26 → 24, dashboard 35 → 33. That is `/meta/page` and `/meta/dashboard` −1 each, plus this PR's view saving on the page route. This PR ships at net zero because PR 2 needs these readers off the lists.

Deviations:
- **`/api/v1/packages` +1 on the page route.** `PageView` now draws on the bundle about 250 ms before the page list would land. Its Studio design gate (`useStudioDesignGate`) therefore asks `/packages` outside the in-flight window the sidebar's gates share. `packages-io.ts` forbids a reuse window, so this PR does not add one.
- **The dashboard route keeps `/meta/view`.** It reads the whole object registry (`objects`), as on main, and the bundle cannot spare that read without changing the dashboard route's whole-registry rule.
- **The object list route keeps `/meta/view`.** `showcase_task`'s lookup target `sys_user` is outside the bundle, so its scope reads the list for the objects the bundle lacks. A reader skips views only where its output is the same without them (`useObjectPresence`).
- File surface past the first claim: `app-bundle.ts`, the new `bundledReads.ts`, `appObjectScope.ts` and `useObjectPresence.ts` (claim amendment 6559809254). `AppContent`'s page route no longer waits for the page list bucket. `RecordDetailView` is unchanged, because `usePageAssignment` still reads the page list on record routes.
- A miss falls back to the list read rather than a by-name read, which keeps prefer-local resolution.
